issues.display_title: Issue #218: Highlight Active Navbar Menu With Bolder Font Weight
issues.main_description_html:
Description

Currently, the navbar menu does not provide a clear visual indication of which page the user is currently viewing. We need to apply a bolder font weight to the active menu item to improve navigation UX.

Acceptance Criteria

  • The system can detect the current route/URL.
  • The navbar menu item that matches the current URL is rendered with a bolder font weight (e.g., font-weight: 600 or 700).
  • The styling updates dynamically when the user navigates between pages without requiring a page refresh (applicable for SPAs like React/Vue/Next.js).

RESULT

Active landing-nav section is now highlighted with font-semibold text-foreground (plus aria-current). Since the landing page is a single page with # anchors, detection uses an IntersectionObserver scroll-spy (band near the viewport top) instead of route matching — it updates live while scrolling, no refresh needed.

Files changed:

  • src/components/landing/LandingNavLinks.tsx (new client component: scroll-spy + nav links)
  • src/components/landing/sections/HeroSections.tsx (SiteHeader renders <LandingNavLinks />)

Branch: feature/218-highlight-active-navbar-menu
Commit: 0f3b150

issues.display_title: Issue #219: Add "Login with Google" Button and Integrate With Backend
issues.main_description_html:
Description

Add a "Login with Google" button on the Sign In / Sign Up page to allow users to authenticate easily without typing an email and password.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Add a "Login with Google" button with the standard Google logo/icon that matches the UI design system.
  • When clicked, redirect the user to the Google Consent Screen (via Google Identity library, Firebase Auth, or direct BE endpoint).
  • Display a loading state (spinner or disable button) during the authentication process.
  • Capture the authentication response/token from the backend and save it securely (local storage/cookies/state management).
  • Handle errors gracefully if the user cancels the login or if a network failure occurs (show a toast/alert notification).

RESULT

"Login with Google" is live on both the Sign in and Create account pages, with the official Google logo, an "or" divider, a redirecting/disabled loading state, and inline error alert when the user cancels or the network fails (NextAuth lands back on /login?error=…).

Architecture (decided with PM): NextAuth's Google provider runs the OAuth dance (state/CSRF handled for us); the signIn callback exchanges the Google id_token at POST /v1/auth/google (built in Gothru-3d-Floormap-API-GO #75) for a Go-issued JWT, so session.accessToken is identical to credentials login — every existing API call keeps working.

Files changed:

  • src/auth.ts (Google provider + signIn callback token exchange)
  • src/components/auth/GoogleSignInButton.tsx (new)
  • src/app/(auth)/login/login-form.tsx, src/app/(auth)/register/register-form.tsx (button + divider; login also surfaces ?error=)
  • .env.example (AUTH_GOOGLE_ID / AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET)

Setup required before testing: create an OAuth client in Google Cloud Console, register redirect URI <origin>/api/auth/callback/google, set AUTH_GOOGLE_ID/AUTH_GOOGLE_SECRET (FE) and GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID (Go API).

Branch: feature/219-login-with-google
Commit: e713ef8

issues.display_title: Issue #220: Add Navigation Back to Landing Page From Login Page
issues.main_description_html:
Description

Based on the current UI on the /login page, users do not have a way to navigate back to the main landing page. If a user lands on this page by mistake or changes their mind about signing in, they should be able to easily return to the home page. We need to make the "MapThru" logo clickable or add a clear "Back to Home" button.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Wrap the "MapThru" logo in the top left corner of the auth layout with a link component (e.g., <Link href="/"> or <a> tag).
  • Ensure that clicking the logo redirects the user back to the landing page (/).
  • Add a cursor-pointer (or equivalent CSS) hover effect to the logo so users know it is clickable.
  • (Optional) If preferred by design, add a small "← Back to Home" text link somewhere visible on the page.
  • Ensure this "back to home" behavior is applied consistently across all related authentication pages (Login, Create an account, Forgot password).

RESULT

The MapThru logo in the shared auth layout is now wrapped in <Link href="/"> with aria-label and a focus ring; the anchor gives the pointer cursor natively. Because Login, Register, Forgot/Reset password, and Verify email all render through src/app/(auth)/layout.tsx, one change covers every auth page. The optional "← Back to Home" text link was skipped — the clickable logo satisfies the requirement.

Files changed:

  • src/app/(auth)/layout.tsx

Branch: feature/220-back-to-landing-from-login
Commit: a17dac8

issues.display_title: Issue #221: Convert floorplan & panoramas API routes to Server Actions, remove dead /api/reset
issues.main_description_html:
Description

The FE has grown one custom API route per proxy need. Small JSON proxies don't need routes — Server Actions do the same server-side fetch with less surface. Streaming (scan, predict), URL-addressed resources (tiles, /api/files GET used as <img src>), upload progress (XHR), and NextAuth stay as routes.

Acceptance Criteria

  • /api/floorplan GET/POST replaced by getFloorplanAction / saveFloorplanAction; all callers switched (EditorTopbar, useWizardPersistence, preview page, live page); route deleted.
  • /api/panoramas replaced by a server action; fetchTourPanoramas uses it; route deleted.
  • EditLevelModal file deletes reuse the existing deleteFileAction instead of direct /api/files DELETE calls.
  • /api/reset deleted (no callers).
  • /api/files GET keeps working as image src for dashboard thumbnails and wizard previews.
  • Typecheck, lint, and tests green.

Ibnu Rizqia Ramadan — Developer

RESULT

Net −78 lines. Three routes deleted, three server actions in their place:

  • getFloorplanAction / saveFloorplanAction (in src/actions/projects.ts) replace /api/floorplan; switched all five callers (EditorTopbar autosave + manual save, useWizardPersistence restore, /preview page, /live page).
  • fetchPublicPanoramasAction (new src/actions/panoramas.ts) replaces /api/panoramas; fetchTourPanoramas in src/lib/tourmkr/pano.ts now calls it.
  • EditLevelModal's three fire-and-forget file deletes reuse the existing deleteFileAction — no more direct /api/files DELETE from the client.
  • /api/reset removed (zero callers).
  • /api/files GET untouched — it serves <img src> URLs for dashboard thumbnails and wizard previews.

Kept as routes (by design): scan + predict (SSE streaming), tiles (URL-addressed by MapLibre), upload (XHR progress), NextAuth.

Typecheck, lint, and 203 tests green.

Branch: feature/221-api-routes-to-server-actions
Commit: 808a756

  • Users must provide accurate account information and are responsible for account security.

  • Users retain ownership of their uploaded floor plans and geospatial data.
  • Governed by Ontario law and Toronto courts.
  • Contact: support@gothru.co / https://gothru.co/

Acceptance Criteria

  • Terms of Service page renders the full copy from the source Google Doc.
  • Page uses the app layout/typography and is responsive.

/terms renders the full Terms of Service copy from the source Google Doc (all 8 sections, "Last updated: July 14, 2026"), using a new shared LegalShell + LegalSection layout (app typography, light/dark, responsive, logo linking home). Linked from the landing footer bottom row (Terms + Privacy) and the auth layout footer on every auth page; /terms and /privacy added to the sitemap.
